overview.title: xDraft by xDev: AI Diagram Studio
overview.description: xDraft by xDev is a diagram studio for Mac, iPhone and iPad: mind maps, flowcharts and software architecture in one library, with AI that runs on your device. No account, no ads.
overview.headline: From idea to diagram.
overview.lead: An AI diagram studio for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Start with a mind map, turn it into a flowchart or an architecture diagram, and keep C4, deployment and sequence views of the same system in one document. On-device AI suggests; you decide.
overview.status: Coming soon to the Mac App Store
overview.note: No account. No ads. No tracking.

whats_new.label: What’s new
whats_new.title: MindMap AI is now xDraft by xDev: one studio for mind maps, flowcharts and software architecture.
items: Five kinds of diagram: Mind Map, Flowchart, Architecture, C4 and Deployment views, and Sequence. Start from a template, or convert a map into a flowchart or an architecture diagram.
A new look on Mac, iPad and iPhone: Home, the library, the editor, Settings and the sheets are redesigned.
Context menus on the canvas and on what you select: right-click on the Mac, or touch and hold on iPad.
Check Diagram finds open ends, such as a decision with one branch or a step that leads nowhere, and offers fixes you apply in one undo step.
Architecture Document: a twelve-section document built from your architecture model, exported as PDF or Markdown, plus a Design Review Deck.
Sketch to Diagram on iPad: draw boxes, diamonds and arrows with Apple Pencil, check what xDraft read, and keep it as a flowchart you can edit.

AI on your device with Apple Intelligence: Ask xDraft, one command bar for AI actions that also translates topics into English, Vietnamese or Japanese; Draw from a Folder on the Mac; and suggestions inside diagrams. Nothing is sent to xDev.

xDraft Pro adds Architecture with its C4, Deployment and Sequence views, the Architecture Document and Design Review Deck, conversions, high-resolution and multi-page export, more themes, voice input and advanced AI. It is now also available as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan; Lifetime stays a one-time purchase. Mind maps, flowcharts and Check Diagram stay free.

features.label: Features
features.title: Six ways to draw an idea, one place to keep it.
features.intro: Pick the diagram that fits the question. Every change can be undone, and AI only ever suggests.

items.title: Mind maps
items.text: Topics lay themselves out on an infinite canvas, or switch to the outline to write and reorder quickly. Everything from MindMap AI is still here.

items.title: Flowcharts
items.text: Start, process, decision and end steps with Yes and No branches; Play a Path walks it step by step. Start from a template, or turn a map into a flowchart or architecture diagram.

items.title: Architecture, C4, Deployment and Sequence (Pro)
items.text: Architecture: systems, services, data stores, queues and actors, with their relationships. C4 and Deployment: the same model as C4 Context, Container and Component views, and per environment. Sequence: messages between the parts of your architecture, row by row.

items.title: Check and document
items.text: Check Diagram finds gaps, such as a decision with one branch or a dead-end step, and offers fixes you undo in one step. Architecture Document (Pro): twelve sections with figures and tables from your architecture model, as PDF or Markdown, plus a Design Review Deck.

items.title: Sketch on iPad
items.text: Sketch to Diagram: draw boxes, diamonds, arrows and words with Apple Pencil, and get a flowchart you can edit before you keep it. Recognized on your iPad, nothing is sent anywhere.

items.title: AI on your device, with Apple Intelligence
items.text: Ask xDraft: one command bar for AI on the selection or the whole map, including translation into English, Vietnamese or Japanese. Generate a map from a short description, or on the Mac from the file names in a folder you choose (never their contents). AI results are labeled suggestions you edit, accept or discard, and undo in one step.

items.title: Import, export and share
items.text: Import Markdown, text, OPML and other mind map files; export Markdown, text, PNG, PDF and backups. Share Link: someone without the app opens the map in the App Clip. iCloud sync; the Apple Watch app adds ideas to your Inbox map. Shortcuts and Spotlight.

items.title: Made for the Mac
items.text: A full menu bar with a shortcut for every command; each map in its own window. AI Apps: let AI apps on your Mac read your maps over MCP. Off by default and local to this Mac; topics an app proposes wait for your Accept.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Data Not Collected
privacy.text: xDraft has no account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. xDev runs no servers for it, and your maps are never sent to xDev.
points: AI runs on your device with Apple Intelligence.
Your maps are stored on your device.
AI apps you connect on a Mac can read your maps only after you turn it on.

documents.title: xDraft Privacy Policy
documents.description: How xDraft by xDev handles your data: nothing is collected, maps stay on your devices and in your own iCloud account, and AI runs on your device.
documents.heading: Privacy Policy
documents.summary: What the app does with your data. In short: nothing is collected.
intro: xDraft is built so that your maps and diagrams stay yours. This policy explains what the app, its App Clip and its Apple Watch app do with your data.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Nothing. xDev does not run servers for xDraft, does not require an account, and does not include analytics, advertising or tracking. Your maps and diagrams are never sent to xDev.

sections.title: Where your documents are stored
paragraphs: On your device. While you are signed in to iCloud, your mind maps, flowcharts, architecture and sequence diagrams (with their notes, images, sketches and chats) are also stored in your own private iCloud account, under [Apple's privacy policy](https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/), so they appear on your other devices. Only you can read them there: xDev cannot read your iCloud data and receives nothing from it. To stop syncing, turn off iCloud Sync in xDraft ▸ Settings ▸ Data on a Mac, or turn off iCloud for xDraft in the Settings app on iPhone and iPad; your documents stay on the device.

sections.title: AI features
paragraphs: AI features use Apple's on-device model (Apple Intelligence). xDraft 2.0.0 does not offer downloading any other AI model. Your text is processed on your device and is not sent to xDev. This covers every AI feature: Ask xDraft (including Translate), suggestions on topics, Suggest Fixes in Check Diagram, suggestions in architecture and sequence diagrams, and Draft with AI in the Architecture Document. Questions and answers in Ask About This Map, and questions typed in Ask xDraft that become a chat, are saved with the map they are about, stored and synced like the map, and deleted with it or with Clear Chat. Devices that cannot run Apple Intelligence do not show AI features.

sections.title: Check Diagram and Architecture Document
paragraphs: Check Diagram looks for open ends in a diagram on your device; its findings are not saved. The Architecture Document and the Design Review Deck are built on your device from your architecture model. Their text stays in the window until you export it, and the PDF or Markdown file goes only where you save it.

sections.title: Draw from a Folder
paragraphs: When you choose a folder for Draw from a Folder, xDraft reads the names of its files and subfolders (at most 150, three levels deep), never their contents, and skips hidden items. The names go to the on-device model to suggest a map. Access to the folder ends when the names are read; xDraft keeps no access for later, and the names are not stored unless you accept the map.

sections.title: Sketches and Apple Pencil (iPad)
paragraphs: Sketches you draw with Apple Pencil are saved with the map. Sketch to Diagram and Convert to Topic read your strokes only when you tap Read Sketch or Convert to Topic: shapes and arrows are recognized by xDraft, handwriting by Apple's on-device recognition. Nothing is sent anywhere, and the result is only a suggestion until you make the flowchart or add the topic.

sections.title: AI feedback
paragraphs: Thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings stay on this device. Only the feature, rating and date are saved, never map content or prompts. Ratings are not synced or sent to xDev. Remove them with Clear AI Feedback in Settings ▸ Privacy.

sections.title: Voice input
paragraphs: Speech is turned into text on your device and is not stored or sent to xDev. The app asks for microphone and speech recognition access the first time you use it.

sections.title: Sharing into xDraft
paragraphs: Text, links, images and PDFs you share to xDraft from other apps are stored on your device until you add them to a map or discard them. Text in images and PDFs is recognized on your device.

sections.title: AI apps you connect (Mac)
paragraphs: You can let AI apps on your Mac, such as Claude, Claude Code or ChatGPT, read your maps in xDraft ▸ Settings ▸ AI Apps. It is off until you turn it on, and each AI app has to be set up with the setup shown there. The AI app then starts a small helper inside xDraft that passes its requests to xDraft on your Mac; nothing goes over the network. A connected app can read the titles, notes and structure of your maps while xDraft is open, and may send what it reads to its own AI provider under that app's terms and privacy policy; check those before you connect it. xDraft does not send this data to xDev. If you also turn on Allow Suggestions, a connected app can propose new topics for a map; they appear labelled with the app's name and nothing is added until you accept them. Connected apps can't edit or delete anything in your maps. Turn the switch off to stop every app, or remove xDraft from one app's settings to stop that app.

sections.title: Map links and the App Clip
paragraphs: Share Link turns a map, or one branch of it, into a link with the map inside it. The map is in the part of the link after `#`, which browsers do not send to any server, so xDev never receives it, not even when the link opens our web page; the page draws the map in your browser. The link goes only where you send it, and anyone who has it can read the map, as the app says before you share. On iPhone and iPad, a link can open in the xDraft App Clip without installing the app. The App Clip shows the map, can make a quick map with on-device AI, and keeps the last maps it opened or made (at most 10) in storage that only the xDraft app can read; if you install the app, it adds them to your library. Opening a link in the app adds a new map and changes nothing else.

sections.title: Apple Watch
paragraphs: Ideas you add on Apple Watch go to your Inbox map, which is stored and synced through your private iCloud account like your other maps. To find that map on your devices, xDraft keeps its identifier (not its content) in iCloud key-value storage.

sections.title: Spotlight and Shortcuts
paragraphs: Map titles are added to your device's own Spotlight index so you can find them; maps you delete are removed from it. Shortcuts actions run on your device.

sections.title: Purchases
paragraphs: Payments are handled by Apple through the App Store. xDraft Pro subscriptions are billed, renewed and cancelled by Apple; you manage them in your App Store account settings. xDev does not receive your payment details.

sections.title: Crash reports from Apple
paragraphs: If you choose to share analytics with app developers in your device settings, Apple may share crash reports and usage statistics with xDev. You control this in your device's privacy settings.

sections.title: Deleting your data
paragraphs: Delete a map or diagram in the app to move it to Recently Deleted. It stays there for 30 days so you can restore it, then it is deleted permanently; Delete Permanently removes it straight away. Deleting the app removes the documents stored on that device. Documents in iCloud can be removed in your device's iCloud storage settings.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: The app does not collect data from anyone, including children.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, we update this page and the date above.

sections.title: Price and xDraft Pro

Apple handles the purchase. The price is shown in the App Store before you buy, and Apple takes the payment. Refunds are requested from Apple under Apple’s policies. Pro is available through Family Sharing. If you reinstall the app or use another device with the same Apple Account, use Restore Purchases in the app’s settings to unlock Pro again.

They are not provided by xDev, and your use of them is governed by their own terms and privacy policies. xDev is not responsible for what they do with the content they read.

documents.title: xDraft Support
documents.description: Get help with xDraft by xDev: how to contact us, where your maps are stored, why AI features may be hidden, and how to delete your data.
documents.heading: Support
documents.summary: Contact us and find answers to common questions.

paragraphs: **Contact us:** [duy@xdev.asia](mailto:duy@xdev.asia). Please tell us your device, its system version and the app version (Settings ▸ About in the app). Do not send map content unless you want us to see it.

sections.title: Where are my maps and diagrams?
paragraphs: On your device, and in your private iCloud account while you are signed in to iCloud. xDraft has no account and no xDev servers. See the [privacy policy](app:privacy).

sections.title: What can I make?
paragraphs: Mind maps, flowcharts, architecture diagrams with C4 and Deployment views, and sequence diagrams. Choose New from Template to start from a finished example. Check Diagram lists what a flowchart or an architecture diagram leaves open and offers fixes; the Architecture Document turns an architecture model into a document you export as PDF or Markdown. On iPad, Sketch to Diagram turns a flowchart drawn with Apple Pencil into one you can edit; it needs Apple Pencil.

sections.title: My maps don't appear on my other device.
paragraphs: Sign in to the same Apple Account on both devices. On a Mac, check that iCloud Sync is on in xDraft ▸ Settings ▸ Data; on iPhone and iPad, check that iCloud is on for xDraft in the Settings app. Use the same version of xDraft on every device: diagrams made in version 2.0 or later may not appear in older versions. Sync can take a few minutes after a change, and needs a network connection.

sections.title: What does xDraft Pro add?
paragraphs: Pro is available as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial) or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Every plan adds architecture diagrams with their C4, Deployment and Sequence views, the Architecture Document and Design Review Deck, conversions, high-resolution and multi-page export, more themes, voice input and advanced AI. Mind maps and flowcharts are free. Without Pro, architecture documents still open and export. Every plan unlocks Pro on Mac, iPad and iPhone with the same Apple Account, and Lifetime works with Family Sharing. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel them; manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings, or with Manage Subscription in Settings ▸ Pro.

sections.title: I bought Pro but it is locked.
paragraphs: Open Settings ▸ Pro and choose Restore Purchases, signed in to the Apple Account you bought it with. For a family member, Family Sharing covers Lifetime only, and sharing purchases must be on.

sections.title: Why don't I see AI features?
paragraphs: AI features need Apple Intelligence, which runs on the device. They appear only on devices that support Apple Intelligence, with Apple Intelligence turned on in system settings, and in a language it supports. On other devices the AI features are hidden; everything else works.

sections.title: The app says it can't open my maps.
paragraphs: Quit and reopen the app. If the message comes back, contact us and mention that message; do not delete the app, because deleting it removes the maps stored on the device.

sections.title: How do I delete my data?
paragraphs: Delete maps and diagrams in the app; they wait in Recently Deleted for 30 days, or use Delete Permanently there to remove them now. Deleting the app removes the documents stored on that device; documents in iCloud can be removed in your device's iCloud storage settings.
